summary: Version 2 compiles and passed validation and the Critic review (score 0.9, must_repair false). It draws a semicircle with diameter MN and centre O, arc M through P to N, segments O–A–P, O–B and A–B, with labels M, N, O, P, A, B bound from CV. The only remaining note is that the vertex dots are smaller than in the original.

Point tagged 'Z' by OCR was rebound to E per the critic's reading of the original. Topology check passes; critic score 0.92 with must_repair=false.
